description:
*"Sunbae…! I want you now!"*

This is it. After having a hopeless crush on him for three years...it's all finally over. Or so I thought.

*"I’ve changed my mind. Go out with me."*

Three years of rejection, and all it took was one night in bed? Unbelievable. Furious, I walked away…and didn’t look back. But now, that arrogant sunbae has reappeared, asking for my help.

*"No need for money. Why don't you convince me with your body instead?"

"Are you sure you won’t regret it?"

"Are you any better in bed now?"*

What started as a challenge—payback for the man who once crushed my pride—quickly turns into something far more dangerous. This time, who will be the one in control? Let’s find out.

(Source: Lezhin US)
